headline: Red Rainfall Warning Raised Over Zambales, Bataan, Pampanga and Parts of Luzon
seoTitle: Red Rainfall Warning Over Central Luzon August 29 | FMB News
seoDescription: PAGASA raised red rainfall warnings over Zambales, Bataan, Pampanga and other parts of Luzon on August 29 as Habagat rains intensified.
deck: Serious flooding was possible in areas under the highest rainfall warning as the southwest monsoon continued to affect Luzon.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: PAGASA raised the red rainfall warning over Zambales, Bataan and Pampanga on Saturday, August 29, with portions of Bulacan and Batangas also included in morning red-warning bulletins.
Metro Manila and several nearby areas were placed under orange warning during parts of the morning, indicating that flooding remained threatening.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The warnings came after days of monsoon rain had already saturated river basins and low-lying communities across Central Luzon.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: Under a red rainfall warning, serious flooding is expected in flood-prone areas. Residents near rivers, drainage channels and unstable slopes need to act on local evacuation instructions.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Warning coverage changed through the day, so residents were advised to rely on the latest PAGASA and local disaster-office bulletins rather than an earlier map.
